definitions.gloss: tone of voice; force of one's words
definitions.explanation: The feeling or force carried by the way something is said, especially how strong or sharp it is. Mostly in {語気|ごき}を{強|つよ}める (to speak more forcefully) and {語気|ごき}が{荒|あら}い (to speak harshly). A written word, frequent in news and novels.

examples.japanese: {語気|ごき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}めた→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{語気|ごき}⟦{鋭|するど}く→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{反論|はんろん}した→反論する：17280_hanronsuru⟧。

⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}される→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{語気|ごき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}めた→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧。
examples.english: When questioned by a reporter, the minister said firmly, "There is no such fact."

notes:
⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (words) + ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, feeling). In news reports, 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{語気|ごき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}めた→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧ is a set way to say someone spoke emphatically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語気|ごき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}める→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧: to speak more forcefully
- {語気|ごき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧: to speak harshly
- {語気|ごき}⟦{鋭|するど}く→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: sharply, in a cutting tone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧: tone, way of talking; neutral, everyday
- ⟦{語調|ごちょう}→語調：17005_gochou⟧: tone of speech; close to {語気|ごき}, a little more about rhythm and style
